title: Stanford physicist proposes quantum gravity theory with GPT-6 Astra
description: Stanford physicist Venkatesa Chandrasekaran posted a preprint proposing a quantum theory of vacuum gravity built on intersecting light cones. The paper reports a finite graviton-pair amplitude and recovers the known black-hole entropy correction. He says he developed several calculations with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra over months, using about 400 million tokens. The preprint is unverified.
